KKA0175-PCKWOT8.lead: An all-round chef's knife for daily chopping at the prep counter.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic White Handle SS Chef Knife in size 8 pairs a stainless steel blade with a white plastic grip. The dimension photo shows a 20.1 cm blade, 4.7 cm deep at the heel, and 30.7 cm from tip to handle end.

Listing photos show it mincing garlic and slicing tomatoes on a wooden board, the onion, garlic, herb and vegetable work that fills a morning mise en place. As the shortest of the three sizes, it sits comfortably on a crowded station or a small board.
b: Size: Size 8, with a 20.1 cm cutting edge and 4.7 cm depth at the heel in the dimension photo.
Material: Stainless steel blade set into a white plastic handle.
Best at: Garlic, herbs, onions, tomatoes and other daily vegetable prep.
KKA0175-PCKWOT8.suit: Restaurant prep lines, hotel kitchens, cloud kitchens and home cooks who want one chef's knife for daily vegetable work.
KKA0175-PCKWOT8.care: Hand wash after each use and wipe it dry straight away. Keep it on a magnetic strip or in a sheath, and always carry it point down.
KKA0175-PCKWOT8.title: SS Chef Knife 8 White Plastic Handle
KKA0175-PCKWOT8.meta: Kitchenary Kart SS chef knife, size 8: 20.1 cm stainless blade and white plastic handle for chopping garlic, herbs and vegetables in busy kitchens.

KKA0176-PCKWOT10.lead: A longer chef's knife for bulk chopping and slicing.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic White Handle SS Chef Knife, size 10, measures 37.7 cm overall in the listing's dimension photo, with a 25.2 cm stainless steel blade that is 5.1 cm deep near the grip.
The extra length helps with batch work: trays of sliced tomatoes, cucumber rounds or minced garlic for a dinner service or a catering order. The white plastic handle wipes clean between tasks.
b: Blade size: Size 10, a 25.2 cm blade and 37.7 cm overall length in the dimension photo.
Material: Stainless steel blade set into a white plastic handle.
Workload: Volume slicing of tomatoes, cucumbers and onions for large prep batches.
KKA0176-PCKWOT10.suit: Banquet kitchens, caterers and busy restaurant prep counters that cut vegetables in bulk.
KKA0176-PCKWOT10.care: Wash by hand, dry at once and park the knife on a magnetic strip or in a sheath; never leave it loose in a sink of water.
KKA0176-PCKWOT10.title: SS Chef Knife 10 White Handle 25cm Blade
KKA0176-PCKWOT10.meta: Size 10 SS chef knife from Kitchenary Kart with a 25.2 cm stainless blade and white plastic handle, for bulk vegetable prep in hotels and catering.

KKA0177-PCKWOT12.lead: The longest of the three chef's knife sizes, for large cuts and big produce.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic White Handle SS Chef Knife in size 12 has a long, tapering stainless steel blade: 30.3 cm in the dimension photo, 42.7 cm overall and 5.1 cm deep at the heel.

Photos show it carving slices from a roast brisket and cutting through a whole watermelon, jobs where a long edge can finish a slice in a single stroke. Reach for it when roast meats, melons and other large produce come to the board.
b: Size: Size 12, with a 30.3 cm blade shown in the dimension photo.
Material: Stainless steel blade set into a white plastic handle.
Shown cutting: Roast brisket and a whole watermelon.
KKA0177-PCKWOT12.suit: Carving stations, buffet counters, fruit sections and hotel kitchens that handle roasts and whole melons.
KKA0177-PCKWOT12.care: Hand wash only and towel it dry immediately. Store it sheathed or on a wall strip, edge facing away from anyone reaching past.
KKA0177-PCKWOT12.title: SS Chef Knife 12 White Handle, 30cm Blade
KKA0177-PCKWOT12.meta: Kitchenary Kart size 12 stainless steel chef knife with a 30.3 cm blade and white handle, for carving roasts and slicing melons at buffets and hotels.

KKA0180-WBKBT10.lead: A bread knife with large, wavy serrations for crusty loaves.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Bread Knife with Big Teeth, size 10, has a long serrated blade with a rounded tip. The dimension photo gives a 24.5 cm blade and 37.5 cm overall length.

The coarse serrations bite into a hard crust and saw through it without crushing the soft crumb, which is why listing photos show it cutting a baguette-style loaf on a wooden board. Bakeries, sandwich counters and breakfast buffets can keep it for French loaves, pav and rustic breads.
b: Blade size: Size 10, a 24.5 cm serrated blade, 3 cm wide, with a 13 cm grip.
Edge: Big, widely spaced teeth and a rounded tip.
Handle: Wooden, fixed with three rivets.
KKA0180-WBKBT10.suit: Bakeries, sandwich shops and breakfast buffets that slice baguettes, French loaves and pav.
KKA0180-WBKBT10.care: Wash by hand and dry straight away; do not soak the wood. Brush crumbs out of the teeth with a soft brush, never with fingers.
KKA0180-WBKBT10.title: Big Teeth Bread Knife 10, Wooden Handle
KKA0180-WBKBT10.meta: Kitchenary Kart size 10 bread knife with big serrated teeth and a wooden handle: 24.5 cm blade for crusty loaves, baguettes and pav at bakeries.

KKA0181-WBKBT14.lead: A long, big-toothed bread knife for wide loaves and long baguettes.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Bread Knife with Big Teeth in size 14 carries a 34.5 cm serrated blade on a 13 cm wooden handle, 47.5 cm overall in the dimension photo.

That reach lets one stroke cross a full sandwich loaf or a long French stick, so slices come out even and the crust stays intact. Choose it for busy bakery counters, hotel breakfast buffets and caterers working through loaves in bulk.
b: Blade size: Size 14, 34.5 cm long and 3 cm wide.
Edge: Big, widely spaced teeth and a rounded tip.
Handle: Wooden, fixed with three rivets.
KKA0181-WBKBT14.suit: Bakery counters, hotel bread stations and caterers slicing whole loaves in large numbers.
KKA0181-WBKBT14.care: Clean by hand with warm soapy water, dry immediately and keep the wood out of soaking tubs. Hang it on a knife strip or sheath it so the teeth stay clear of hands.
KKA0181-WBKBT14.title: Big Teeth Bread Knife 14, 34.5cm Blade
KKA0181-WBKBT14.meta: Size 14 bread knife with big teeth from Kitchenary Kart: 34.5 cm serrated blade and wooden handle for slicing long loaves at bakeries and hotels.

KKA0182-WBKST8.lead: A fine-toothed knife sized for everyday sandwich loaves.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Bread Knife with Small Teeth, size 8, has a finely serrated 19.5 cm steel blade with a rounded tip, fixed to a 13 cm wooden handle; the dimension photo puts it at 32.5 cm overall.
Small, close-set teeth cut soft sandwich loaves and buns into neat slices with little tearing. The compact length is handy at a café counter or a small bakery where board space is tight.
b: Blade size: Size 8, a 19.5 cm serrated blade, 3 cm wide.
Build: Steel blade with fine teeth; wooden handle held by three rivets.
Shown with: A sliced sandwich loaf and a plate of toast slices.
KKA0182-WBKST8.suit: Cafés, sandwich counters and small bakeries slicing soft bread and buns.
KKA0182-WBKST8.care: Hand wash, dry at once and never leave the wooden handle standing in water. Store it in a sheath or on a magnetic bar with the teeth turned away from you.
KKA0182-WBKST8.title: Small Teeth Bread Knife 8, Wooden Handle
KKA0182-WBKST8.meta: Kitchenary Kart size 8 small-teeth bread knife: 19.5 cm fine serrated steel blade and wooden handle for neat sandwich bread slices at cafés.

KKA0183-WBKST10.lead: A mid-length bread knife with fine serrations for sliced loaves.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Bread Knife with Small Teeth in size 10 has a 24.5 cm blade with close-set serrations and a rounded tip. With its 13 cm wooden handle it measures 37.5 cm overall in the dimension photo.
It handles standard sandwich loaves, brioche and milk bread without flattening the slices. Hotel breakfast teams and sandwich kitchens can keep it next to the toaster line.
b: Size: Size 10, a 24.5 cm blade, 3 cm wide, on a 13 cm handle.
Build: Steel blade with fine teeth; wooden handle held by three rivets.
Tip: Rounded, with no sharp point at the end.
KKA0183-WBKST10.suit: Hotel breakfast kitchens, sandwich units and cafés cutting sandwich loaves and brioche.
KKA0183-WBKST10.care: Wash it by hand, dry it right away and keep the wood away from long soaks. Put it back in its sheath or on the wall strip rather than in a drawer of loose tools.
KKA0183-WBKST10.title: Small Teeth Bread Knife 10, 24.5cm Blade
KKA0183-WBKST10.meta: Size 10 fine-toothed bread knife by Kitchenary Kart, 24.5 cm steel blade with wooden handle, for sandwich loaves and brioche in hotels and cafés.

KKA0184-WBKST12.lead: A long, fine-toothed knife for large loaves and bakery slicing.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Bread Knife with Small Teeth, size 12, pairs a 29.5 cm finely serrated blade with a 13 cm three-rivet wooden handle, 42.5 cm end to end in the dimension photo.
The longer edge reaches across a jumbo sandwich loaf or a wide round loaf, keeping slices even for sandwich platters. Bakeries that slice to order at the counter can keep it beside the display.
b: Blade size: Size 12, 29.5 cm long and 3 cm wide.
Build: Steel blade with fine teeth; wooden handle held by three rivets.
Reach: Spans a jumbo sandwich loaf or a wide round loaf.
KKA0184-WBKST12.suit: Bakeries slicing to order, sandwich platter kitchens and catering units handling large loaves.
KKA0184-WBKST12.care: After use, hand wash and dry the blade and handle straight away, as soaking can harm the wood. Keep the edge sheathed or on a knife strip between shifts.
KKA0184-WBKST12.title: Small Teeth Bread Knife 12, Wooden Handle
KKA0184-WBKST12.meta: Kitchenary Kart size 12 bread knife with small teeth: 29.5 cm serrated steel blade on a wooden handle for large loaves at bakeries and caterers.

KKA0185-WBKST14.lead: The longest of the four fine-toothed sizes, for extra-wide bakes.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Bread Knife with Small Teeth in size 14 has a 34.5 cm blade with fine serrations and a rounded end, set in a 13 cm wooden handle; overall length is 47.5 cm in the dimension photo.

Use it for long pullman loaves, large focaccia slabs and party-size breads where a short blade would need several sawing strokes. Its length also makes it a steady choice for a bakery's bread-slicing table.
b: Blade: Size 14, a 34.5 cm serrated edge, 3 cm wide.
Construction: Fine-toothed steel blade; three-rivet wooden handle.
Loaf types: Pullman loaves, focaccia slabs and large party breads.
KKA0185-WBKST14.suit: Bakery slicing tables, hotel banquet kitchens and caterers cutting long pullman loaves and focaccia.
KKA0185-WBKST14.care: Hand wash, then dry fully at once; do not leave the wooden handle in soaking water. Store on a magnetic strip or in a sheath, teeth pointing away from the user.
KKA0185-WBKST14.title: Small Teeth Bread Knife 14, 34.5cm Blade
KKA0185-WBKST14.meta: Size 14 small-teeth bread knife from Kitchenary Kart with a 34.5 cm serrated steel blade and wooden handle, for pullman loaves and focaccia slabs.

KKA0186-MKH38.lead: A magnetic strip for the wall that keeps knives off the counter and within reach.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Magnetic Knife Holder in the 38cm size is a black bar, 38 cm long and 5 cm wide, with two magnetic strips along its face and two screw holes for fixing.

Fixed above a prep table, it keeps chef's knives, scissors and a sharpening steel in view instead of loose in a drawer; one product photo shows those alongside a whisk. The 38 cm length fits the short space above a single workstation or a bar counter.
b: Length: 38 cm, with a 5 cm wide face.
Hardware: Screws and wall plugs shown as included in the detail photo.
Beyond knives: Listing photos also show it holding spanners, keys and stationery.
KKA0186-MKH38.suit: Single prep stations, bar counters, small cafés and home kitchens with little free wall space.
KKA0186-MKH38.care: Fix it to a solid wall with the supplied screws and plugs, then test the grip before hanging heavier knives. Wipe the holder with a damp cloth, dry it, and set each blade spine first so the edge never scrapes the strip.
KKA0186-MKH38.title: Magnetic Knife Holder 38cm Wall Strip
KKA0186-MKH38.meta: Kitchenary Kart 38 cm magnetic knife holder: black wall bar with screws and plugs that keeps knives and tools off the counter at a single prep station.

KKA0187-MKH55.lead: A long magnetic wall bar for stations that run several knives at once.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Magnetic Knife Holder, 55cm size, is a black bar 55 cm long and 5 cm wide with two screw holes for fixing to the wall.

The extra length gives room for chef's knives, a cleaver, kitchen scissors and a sharpening steel side by side, much like the line-up pictured on the bar. Mount it along the back of a main cooking line or a meat-prep table so every blade stays in sight.
b: Length: 55 cm, with a 5 cm wide face.
Hardware: Screws and wall plugs shown as included in the detail photo.
Finish: Black body with two lengthwise magnetic strips.
KKA0187-MKH55.suit: Main cooking lines, meat-prep tables and hotel kitchens that keep many knives and tools at hand.
KKA0187-MKH55.care: Mount on brick, concrete or another firm wall using the included screws and plugs, and check it holds before loading. Clean with a damp cloth, dry, and hang blades spine first with edges pointing away from passing hands.
KKA0187-MKH55.title: Magnetic Knife Holder 55cm Long Wall Bar
KKA0187-MKH55.meta: 55 cm magnetic knife holder from Kitchenary Kart: black wall bar with screws and plugs to hang knives, cleavers and scissors along a busy cooking line.

KKA0188-SPK6.lead: A short straight palette knife for small cakes and detail spreading.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Black Handle Straight Palette Knife in 6 inch has a flat, round-ended metal blade on a black plastic handle, 27.2 cm overall and 3 cm wide in the dimension photo. It is a spreading tool, not a cutting knife.
Use it to spread cream, ganache or buttercream on cupcakes, half-kg cakes and pastry tops, or to nudge small decorations into place. The short blade gives close control on small surfaces.
b: Size: 6 inch, 27.2 cm overall, 3 cm wide.
Build: Straight, flat blade with a rounded end and a black plastic handle.
Best for: Cupcakes, half-kg cakes and pastry tops.
KKA0188-SPK6.suit: Cake shops, home bakers and café pastry counters finishing cupcakes and half-kg cakes.
KKA0188-SPK6.care: Wash by hand in warm water to clear cream and sugar, then dry at once. Store it flat in a drawer tray or hang it so it does not bend.
KKA0188-SPK6.title: Straight Palette Knife 6 inch Black Handle
KKA0188-SPK6.meta: Kitchenary Kart 6 inch straight palette knife with black plastic handle, 27.2 cm long, for spreading cream and ganache on cupcakes and half-kg cakes.

KKA0189-SPK8.lead: An 8 inch palette knife for icing and levelling everyday cakes.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Black Handle Straight Palette Knife, 8 inch, has a straight, flat blade with a rounded end on a black plastic grip, 32.2 cm long in the dimension photo.
This length works well for crumb coats, filling layers and smooth tops on standard 1 kg cakes. Listing photos show it spreading cream across a sponge base on a cake board.
b: Size: 8 inch, 32.2 cm end to end, 3 cm wide.
Build: Straight, flat blade with a rounded end and a black plastic handle.
Job: Crumb coats, filling layers and levelling cream, not cutting.
KKA0189-SPK8.suit: Cake shops and bakeries filling and masking 1 kg cakes through the day.
KKA0189-SPK8.care: Rinse off cream soon after use, hand wash and dry well before storing. Keep it flat or hung up so it stays straight.
KKA0189-SPK8.title: Straight Palette Knife 8 inch for Icing
KKA0189-SPK8.meta: 8 inch straight palette knife by Kitchenary Kart, black plastic handle, 32.2 cm long, for crumb coats and levelling cream on 1 kg cakes at bakeries.

KKA0190-SPK10.lead: A 10 inch palette knife for smoothing the sides and tops of bigger cakes.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Black Handle Straight Palette Knife in 10 inch measures 37.5 cm overall in the dimension photo, with a 3 cm wide straight blade that ends in a rounded tip.
The longer blade reaches across 2 kg cakes and tier bases when smoothing the top and sides, so the icing needs fewer passes. Keep it for masking and levelling; it is not meant for cutting.
b: Size: 10 inch, 37.5 cm overall, 3 cm across.
Build: Straight, flat blade with a rounded end and a black plastic handle.
Work: Masking the sides and tops of 2 kg cakes and tier bases.
KKA0190-SPK10.suit: Cake studios, wedding-cake makers and bakery production tables finishing 2 kg cakes and tiers.
KKA0190-SPK10.care: Hand wash promptly so buttercream and sugar do not dry on, then wipe it dry. Store it flat or hanging to keep it from warping.
KKA0190-SPK10.title: Straight Palette Knife 10 inch, 37.5cm
KKA0190-SPK10.meta: Kitchenary Kart 10 inch straight palette knife, 37.5 cm long with black plastic handle, for smoothing icing on the tops and sides of 2 kg cakes and tiers.

KKA0191-SPK12.lead: A 12 inch palette knife for sheet cakes and large tiers.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Plastic Black Handle Straight Palette Knife, 12 inch, runs 42.5 cm from tip to handle end in the dimension photo, with a 3 cm wide flat blade, rounded end and black plastic grip.
A long straight edge spreads cream evenly across sheet cakes, slab cakes and broad bottom tiers in long sweeps. It fits production tables where many big bakes are finished in a row.
b: Size: 12 inch, 42.5 cm overall, 3 cm across.
Construction: Flat straight blade, rounded end, black plastic handle.
Use: Spreading and levelling cream on big tiers and trays; it is not a cutting knife.
KKA0191-SPK12.suit: Bakery production tables, wedding-cake studios and hotel pastry kitchens icing sheet cakes and wide tiers.
KKA0191-SPK12.care: Wash by hand straight after icing work and dry thoroughly. Hang it or keep it in a flat tray so the long blade is not bent by other tools.
KKA0191-SPK12.title: Straight Palette Knife 12 inch, 42.5cm
KKA0191-SPK12.meta: 12 inch straight palette knife from Kitchenary Kart, 42.5 cm long with black plastic handle, for spreading cream on sheet cakes and wide cake tiers.

KKA0192-SK6.lead: A compact Japanese steel knife for sushi rolls and small fish work.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Japanese Steel Sushi Knife with Cover in size 6 has a narrow, pointed 15 cm blade on a 12 cm three-rivet grip, 3 cm deep at the heel in the dimension photo.

The short length gives control when cutting maki rolls, trimming fish and preparing garnish vegetables, and a listing photo shows a chef slicing peppers and carrots with it. It comes with a cover, so the edge stays protected between uses.
b: Blade: Size 6, 15 cm long and 3 cm deep, with a pointed tip.
Material: Japanese steel blade, wooden handle with three rivets, cover included.
Tasks: Maki rolls, trimming fish, garnish vegetables.
KKA0192-SK6.suit: Sushi counters, Asian kitchens and hotel live stations cutting maki rolls and trimming fish.
KKA0192-SK6.care: Hand wash only and dry it straight away; never soak the wood. Slide it back into its cover before storing, keeping fingers off the edge.
KKA0192-SK6.title: Japanese Steel Sushi Knife 6, 15cm Blade
KKA0192-SK6.meta: Kitchenary Kart size 6 sushi knife: 15 cm Japanese steel blade, wooden handle and cover, for maki rolls and fish trimming at sushi counters.

KKA0193-SK8.lead: A mid-size Japanese steel sushi knife for rolls and fish fillets.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Japanese Steel Sushi Knife with Cover, size 8, carries a slim 20 cm blade that tapers to a point, fixed to a 12 cm wooden handle with three rivets.
It has enough length to draw through sashimi slices and uramaki while staying manageable at a crowded sushi bar. Japanese characters are printed on the blade, and the knife is supplied with a cover.
b: Blade: Size 8, 20 cm long, 3 cm deep.
Material: Japanese steel blade, wooden handle with three rivets, cover included.
Tasks: Sashimi slices, uramaki and fish fillets.
KKA0193-SK8.suit: Sushi bars, pan-Asian restaurants and hotel live counters slicing sashimi and rolls.
KKA0193-SK8.care: Wash by hand, dry at once and keep the wooden handle out of standing water. Sheath the edge in its cover or place it on a magnetic strip after each shift.
KKA0193-SK8.title: Japanese Steel Sushi Knife 8, 20cm Blade
KKA0193-SK8.meta: Size 8 Japanese steel sushi knife by Kitchenary Kart with a 20 cm blade, wooden handle and cover, for sashimi slices and uramaki at busy sushi bars.

KKA0194-SK9.lead: A longer sushi knife for sashimi and larger fish loins.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Japanese Steel Sushi Knife with Cover in size 9 has a long, narrow blade ending in a fine point. The dimension photo shows a 12 cm handle and a blade 3 cm deep.
Use it for drawing clean sashimi slices from salmon and tuna loins or portioning fish for nigiri. A cover is included for storage between services.
b: Size: 9 as listed; blade 3 cm deep, 12 cm grip.
Material: Japanese steel blade, wooden handle with three rivets, cover included.
Tasks: Sashimi from salmon and tuna loins, nigiri portions.
KKA0194-SK9.suit: Sushi restaurants and hotel Japanese kitchens portioning salmon and tuna for sashimi and nigiri.
KKA0194-SK9.care: Clean by hand, dry immediately and do not soak the wood. Put the cover back on before the knife goes into a drawer or tool box.
KKA0194-SK9.title: Japanese Steel Sushi Knife 9 with Cover
KKA0194-SK9.meta: Kitchenary Kart size 9 sushi knife with a Japanese steel blade, wooden handle and cover, for sashimi slices and nigiri portions in sushi kitchens.
conflicts: Blade length: listing size is 9, but the dimension photo shows a 25 cm blade (about 10 in; 9 in would be 22.9 cm). Blade length left out of the copy until the owner confirms.

KKA0195-SK12.lead: The longest of the four sushi knife sizes, for large fish and long sashimi cuts.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Wooden Handle Japanese Steel Sushi Knife with Cover, size 12, has a slender 29.5 cm blade on a 12 cm three-rivet wooden handle, 3 cm deep at the heel in the dimension photo.
The extra reach lets a chef pull each sashimi slice in one long stroke and break down whole salmon sides. With the edge in its cover, it can be carried to outdoor catering and live-counter events.
b: Blade: Size 12, 29.5 cm long, 3 cm deep.
Construction: Japanese steel, three-rivet wooden handle and a protective cover.
Tasks: Long sashimi slices and salmon sides.
KKA0195-SK12.suit: High-volume sushi kitchens, hotel Japanese restaurants and caterers running live sushi counters.
KKA0195-SK12.care: Hand wash, towel dry at once and keep the wood away from soaking. Store it in its cover or on a knife strip, blade turned away from reaching hands.
KKA0195-SK12.title: Japanese Steel Sushi Knife 12 with Cover
KKA0195-SK12.meta: Kitchenary Kart size 12 sushi knife with a 29.5 cm Japanese steel blade, wooden handle and cover, for long sashimi cuts and whole salmon sides.
